feature sentiments can be used to explain recommendations and improve user decision-making in high-investment product domain.

the proposed explanation interface is effective in improving users' decision making in high-investment product domain.

how to effectively leverage product reviews to improve the effectiveness of explanation in high-investment decision environments.

our proposed explanation interface can help users to better understand and make decisions about product recommendations in high-investment domains.
the proposed explanation interface can help users to better explore product space, understand tradeoff properties of recommendations, and make more informed purchase decisions.
feature sentiments extracted from reviews can be a useful source for explaining tradeoff properties of recommendations.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the tradeoffs among product specifications and their sentiments can be a promising way to explain the recommendations, which can help users better understand the products and formulate their preferences for better decision-making.
